Crates are a feature on Donut SMP where you can use a type of resource called "Crate Keys" to open crates.

There are 5 different crates, each with their own corresponding crate key, and in each crate you have a choice of 7 items, where you can pick one.

You can open crates by using the command "/warp crates" and opening one of the crates you have a key for[[File:Common Crate.png|thumb|Common Crate Contents]]Crate keys aren't physical items, but resources in your account. They can be obtained from [[keyall]] (once every hour) and DonutSMP's official store.

EDIT: CRATES GOT REMOVED AS PART OF A LARGER UPDATE!!!

==== Crates: ====
* Common (gives diamond armor / tools)
* Prime (gives netherite armor mace netherite sword or crossbow)
* Gold (gives one of any spawner)
* Amethyst (gives [[Amethyst Items|amethyst items]])
* Crimson (gives netherite armor, sword, axe or pickaxe)
[[File:PRime key.png|thumb|Prime Key]]
